newsitem.title: USA: Cincinnati purchasers say activity rose in June.
newsitem.headline: Cincinnati purchasers say activity rose in June.

text.p: Cincinnati-area economic activity showed a "significant increase" in June, the National Association of Purchasing Management-Cincinnati said Monday.

The group, which does not calculate an overall index for the greater Cincinnati area, said the increase in activity in June versus May was consistent in new orders, order backlog, production, employment and dollars spending by purchasing.
It said vendor delivery performance was unchanged, while commodity and service prices rose at slightly lower rates than in May and stayed below the three-year averages.
